ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is triangle ABC, A is at the lower left, C is at the lower right, and B is above; the left side AB is labeled 13, the base AC is labeled 12, and the right side BC is labeled 15. The problem asks for the measure of ∠A. Then reason: The two adjacent sides of ∠A are AB=13 and AC=12, and the opposite side is BC=15. According to the law of cosines, cos(A)=(AB^2+AC^2-BC^2)/(2·AB·AC)=(13^2+12^2-15^2)/(2·13·12)=(169+144-225)/312=88/312≈0.2821. A=arccos(0.2821)≈73.6°, rounded to the nearest whole degree is 74°.
